Greetings, Agents!

 

This is CM Fragment of MARVEL Future Fight.

 

The well-known tragic couple from the Marvel Universe,
Wanda and Vision have returned to the game spotting all-new looks!

 

Please check out the 2 new uniforms that were inspired by Marvel Studios’ WandaVision.

 

Download the 5/3 patch data
and participate in battles with Wanda and Vision.

 

[5/4 3:27 a.m. (UTC+0) / 5/3 8:27 p.m. (PDT) Added]

The patch has been completed as of 5/4 3:24 a.m. (UTC+0) / 5/3 8:24 p.m. (PDT). 

Please reconnect to the game and download the patch file.


■ 5/3 Patch
Patch Schedule: Scheduled to be completed by 5/4 4:00 a.m. (UTC+0) / 5/3 9:00 p.m. (PDT)
* The patch will be applied in waves, so the patch application time may vary.
* The game can be played during the patch. 
   We recommend our Agents reconnect to the game to apply the patch once it is available.


▣ 2 New Uniforms

 

New uniforms for Vision (White Vision) and Wanda (Scarlet Witch) inspired by Marvel Studios’ WandaVision have been added to the game.

* New uniform Skills are based on Skill Level 6 stats.
* The new uniforms will be available for purchase after applying the 5/3 Patch data and an All Uniforms 50% Sale Event will be applied.
* The 2 new uniforms will be available for purchase in the Marvel Universe and Uniform Room.

 

▣ Vision Tier-3 Ultimate Skill

 

You can advance Vision to Tier-3 after the patch!
Please check out Vision’s powerful energy beam!

 

▣ Other Improvements

 

1. Some stats have been changed for The Thing.
- The ‘Decrease All Defenses’ effect of the Potential Awakened Skill “Earthen Collapse” now ignores immunity.

* Skills are based on the max level stats.
 

2. Some stats have been changed for Mister Fantastic <The Maker>.
- The skill effect stats have improved for Active 4 <Mad Bombardment> and Active 5 <Sphere of Insanity>.
- An ‘Increase All Attacks’ buff has been added to Active 3 <Rubber Cannon>.
- The ‘Increase All Attacks’ buff in the Active 5 <Sphere of Insanity> has changed to an ‘Increase Damage for 1 Attack’ buff.
- The duration of the ‘Decrease Physical Damage’, increased Cooldown time, and HP recovery has been added to the Tier-2 Passive Skill.

* Skills are based on the max level stats.

 

▣ Game Error Fixes

 

1. The issue of being able to apply damage by attacking even though the Frost Beast has a Barrier in Alliance Battle Extreme has been fixed.

 

 

Please welcome these two Super Heroes for becoming even more powerful than before!

 

Thank you.
